name: Content Insights Report Group
description: Group-scoped version of Content Insights Report: the same content-type/status/activity/moderation aggregates and node listing, restricted to the nodes belonging to a single Group.
project_description: Submodule of Content Insights Report. It extends the base module's content analysis to the Group module: instead of a site-wide report it generates the same content-type / status / monthly-activity / moderation-state aggregates and filterable node listing scoped to a single Group's content. Reports are reached from a per-group Report tab (route /group/{group}/reports/content-insights-report-group) and are visible to group members holding the group view permission (or site administrators of the module). Requires the base content_insights_report module plus group and gnode. Configured separately at /admin/config/content/content_insights_report_group/report-settings.
